value: STATED, UNTESTED — that the duplicate trees are DUPLICATES and not DIVERGENT versions. The tree carries at least four copies of the same files (_consolidated_2026-06-29/, lab/, archive/, TheIgors-cert-walks/W1/); the same calibre_catalog.py appears four times. Dedup must VERIFY sameness (hash) and, where copies differ, record the divergence rather than silently picking one. Picking arbitrarily would import a version nobody chose.

value.a: THE QUARRY ALREADY CARRIES A COMPILED INDEX. theigors/theigors/subsystem_index/ is 14 markdown files, each summarizing a subsystem and pointing into its own source (graph_calving.md is the exemplar: what's live, what's pending, which tickets, primary files, gates, shaping decisions). So this node IMPORTS AND NORMALIZES an existing compiled view first, and only then reaches for design_docs/decisions. Deriving from scratch what they already compiled would be the same defect this node exists to fix.

IDEAS-NOT-CODE INVERTS THE RECORD. Akien's ruling 2026-07-26: the quarry 'is a place for ideas to steal, not code' — because it lacked the proving structure and the insistence on being shown each thing working, which is WHY Cairn was started over. held-librarian.json currently states the opposite as settled: 'the MECHANISM crosses nearly intact ... the DESIGN does not.' A future session reads that and starts porting the embeddings generator. The note is stale at the source and needs correcting there, not only here.

THE QUARRY IS NOT A ROOT AND DOES NOT BECOME ONE. It is a referenced external corpus, outside all three roots (~/TheIgorsProject). The INDEX is knowledge, so it berths in CairnCommons; the COMPILER is code with one address, so it berths in cairn/. The roots table has no slot for 'external referenced corpus' — recorded as a distinction, not a collision, since nothing about the three-roots rule is contradicted by reading something outside them.

READING CODE AS EVIDENCE STAYS LEGITIMATE; GRAFTING IT DOES NOT. The Channel pattern was extracted by reading calibre.py, not from a doc. Reading source to EXTRACT an idea is how the ruling is executed; carrying source across is what the ruling forbids. The index does not index code, but entries may POINT at code the way subsystem_index already does.
